create_watchdog: create a watchdog instance with a debug name, timeout, and soft mode to monitor liveness
feed_watchdog: feed a watchdog periodically to reset its timeout counter and prevent false timeout triggers
disable_watchdog: disable a watchdog temporarily using a context manager to skip timeout checks during critical sections
start_subprocess_watchdog: start a subprocess watchdog to monitor multiprocessing processes and trigger SIGQUIT on crash detection
stop_subprocess_watchdog: stop a subprocess watchdog cleanly by signaling its monitor thread and joining with a timeout
